property_summary: When the owner calls approveTransfer with a loanID from a clearRequest, the reference C sets approvals[loanID] to the lender address, while the buggy version (factory returns zero address) causes the clearRequest to revert, so approveTransfer never gets executed; the assertion checks that after the sequence the approvals mapping for loanID is the lender's address.
change_summary: Replace the return statement to return a new CoolerFactory address built from a constant address instead of the immutable factory address from calldata.
